lines.en: My long legs come down one by one

lines.zh: 甲壳压过碎石，声音很脆
lines.en: My shell crushes gravel with a crisp sound

lines.zh: 一米八的高度让我俯视地面
lines.en: One and eight-tenths tall, I look down on the ground

lines.zh: 我八条腿同时向前推进
lines.en: My eight legs advance together
Deep-sea mud clings to my shell

lines.zh: 我擦过树干，留下一道湿痕
lines.en: I brush a trunk and leave a wet smear
My stride is longer than a person's
I crawl from the shore inland

lines.zh: 三点的护甲顶在最前面
lines.en: My three points of armor lead the way
My joints extend and retract

lines.zh: 我走进林子里，树影压低
lines.en: I enter the woods and the shadows drop

lines.zh: 我从低处踩上高处的石头
lines.en: I step from low stone to high stone

lines.zh: 我的腹部拖出一道浅沟
lines.en: My abdomen drags a shallow groove
I head for a warmer place

lines.zh: 我的腿在树干上一撑就过去
lines.en: I brace against a trunk and cross
I go around the villagers' fence
I crouch with my legs spread
My shell breathes slowly
I listen to the faintest vibrations

lines.zh: 八条腿的末节一动不动
lines.en: The tips of my eight legs do not move

lines.zh: 深海的颜色还留在我背上
lines.en: The deep-sea color still stays on my back
I press myself very low
This spot has shade
My mouthparts open and close slowly
I wait for someone to walk into range

lines.zh: 我的影子像一块会动的岩
lines.en: My shadow looks like moving rock

lines.zh: 我把两条前腿举着不动
lines.en: I hold two front legs up, still
I crouch on the shaded side of a stone

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让甲壳轻微震动
lines.en: My breath makes the shell quiver

lines.zh: 这个角度能看见很远的林线
lines.en: From this angle I can see the far treeline
You are quite a bit shorter than me
You have no shell on you

lines.zh: 我在二十四格内就能锁定你
lines.en: I can lock you within twenty-four blocks
You stepped on my line

lines.zh: 我们村子的那种铁家伙呢
lines.en: Where are those iron things from the villages
Back up a little, my legs are long
I am gauging your weight
You look small to me
Do not touch my shell
You smell dry
A line cracked across my shell
That went into a joint gap
I pull in two legs
My armor took most of it
Foam surges in my mouthparts
One hit taken and I answer
My leg joints are shaking.

lines.zh: 深海的血流出来是黑的
lines.en: Deep-sea blood runs black

lines.zh: 关节被砸中，我慢了一步。
lines.en: Struck at the joint, I slow a step.
I will not fall back

lines.zh: 这东西引不动我的口器
lines.en: This does not move my mouthparts

lines.zh: 你把它举得再高我也够得到
lines.en: I can reach it however high you hold it

lines.zh: 这东西在我口器里太小
lines.en: This is too small for my mouthparts

lines.zh: 我的种类早就不靠这个活了
lines.en: My kind stopped living on this long ago
Lower it and let me look
I extend one leg to test it
This smell is not the sea's

lines.zh: 这点东西不值得我停下来
lines.en: This is not worth stopping for
I would rather have something alive

lines.zh: 你手里那点自己留着吧
lines.en: Keep that for yourself

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的腿节上
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my leg joint
I lift one leg to make way
We hit and gravel flies

lines.zh: 你的力气对我不算什么
lines.en: Your force means little to me

lines.zh: 我被你顶得横移了半步
lines.en: You shoved me half a step sideways
My shell scraped out sparks
I take that bump as wind
When you backed off I was still there
I push you aside with one leg

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离还是由我定
lines.en: I still decide the distance between us

lines.zh: 我这种东西不需要那种事
lines.en: Creatures like me have no need of that
My eggs are not here

lines.zh: 海嗣的繁衍不需要这些形式
lines.en: Seaborn propagation needs no such forms
You asked what you should not

lines.zh: 我壳下的器官会自己长
lines.en: The organs under my shell grow on their own
I fold my front legs in
All eight legs shifted at once
This topic displeases me
I turn my body away
I go back to guarding my range
I pinch it up with a forelimb

lines.zh: 这东西在我甲下不算什么
lines.en: This is nothing under my shell
I raise it to my mouthparts
Whatever falls is mine
I pinch and crush it
It does not taste right
I tuck it into a gap in my shell
I keep this for bait
It cracked in my pincers
I toss it aside
You entered twenty-four blocks
All eight of my legs go taut
I will come around the flank
I strike those iron ones all the same
I have chosen my footholds
You moved first, not me
My mouthparts are open
This prey is big enough
My shadow has covered you
Seven damage, all at once
I press in joint by joint
The height gives me good sight

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在土上传得很远
lines.en: Your steps carry far on the soil
I shift sideways out from the tree
Three of my legs lift together
You have backed to the stones
My shell clamps tighter
I am in no hurry, I have many legs
Are you counting my legs

lines.zh: 再近一点，我一个俯冲就够
lines.en: A little closer and one lunge will do

lines.zh: 我的前肢从上方扎下来
lines.en: My forelimbs stab down from above
Seven points, right on the shoulder
All eight legs pull in at once
My mouthparts bite and hold
I drive you toward the ground
The clash of my joints is very close

lines.zh: 我的甲壳顶开你的防御
lines.en: My shell forces your guard open

lines.zh: 一击之后我横移了两个方向
lines.en: After the strike I shift two directions
Seawater seeps from my shell

lines.zh: 我用肩部的甲壳撞过去
lines.en: I drive my shoulder shell forward

lines.zh: 我从岩石缝里撑开身体
lines.en: I open my body out of the rock seam
Eight legs come out first

lines.zh: 我身上的深海泥还在滴
lines.en: Deep-sea mud still drips off me

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，三点护甲
lines.en: Eighty-five health, three points of armor
This shore belongs to me
I rise to one and eight-tenths blocks

lines.zh: 我的甲壳把阳光切成片
lines.en: My shell cuts the sunlight into slices
I wait here for someone to come

lines.zh: 我的出现让地面暗了一块
lines.en: My arrival darkens a patch of ground

lines.zh: 林子里多了一块会走的岩
lines.en: The wood has gained a walking rock

lines.zh: 火焰把我的甲壳烧得爆裂
lines.en: Fire cracked my shell open

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，腿节错位
lines.en: I crashed from a height and a joint slipped
Water forced into my shell gaps
The blast flipped me over entirely

lines.zh: 飞来的东西嵌在我的甲上
lines.en: Something flying lodged in my shell

lines.zh: 那股术力顺着腿节爬上来
lines.en: That magic crept up my joints

lines.zh: 我很久没进食，甲壳在变薄
lines.en: I have not fed in ages, my shell thins
Lightning split my shell surface

lines.zh: 我八条腿下面什么都没有了
lines.en: There is nothing beneath my eight legs
